''Lojban'' is a constructed language. It was originally called ''Loglan'' by project founder ''Dr. James Cooke Brown'', who started the language development in ''1955''. Loglan/Lojban has been built over four decades by dozens of workers and hundreds of supporters, led since ''1987'' by [[The Logical Language Group]].

The following are the main features of Lojban:
* Lojban is designed to be used by people in <u>communication</u> with each other, and possibly in the future with computers.
* Lojban is designed to be <u>culturally neutral</u>.
* Lojban grammar is based on the <u>principles of logic</u>.
* Lojban has an <u>unambiguous grammar</u>.
* Lojban has <u>phonetic spelling</u>, and unambiguous resolution of sounds into words.
* Lojban is <u>simple</u> compared to natural languages; it is easy to learn.
* Lojban's <u>1300 root words</u> can be easily combined to form a vocabulary of <u>millions of words</u>.
* Lojban is regular; the rules of the language are <u>without exception</u>.
* Lojban attempts to <u>remove restrictions</u> on creative and clear thought and communication.
* Lojban has a <u>variety of uses</u>, ranging from the creative to the scientific, from the theoretical to the practical.
For more information on what Lojban is, and why people are learning it, see the [[Lojban|the main page]].

You might also want to consider buying the book [[the Complete Lojban Language]].
